event:
I submitted the verdict as "verified", but only three of the five items stand. I withdrew items 1 and 5. The testbench tests those two, in `mci_mbox_ownership_flow.svh`.

- **`cr_1742179d80a0` (SRAM_OWNER 0 means no owner): withdrawn.** After each release the flow checks that the owner reads back as NONE.
- **`cr_666421936fb3` (value 0 encodes BUSY): verified.** BUSY exists only as an enum in `caliptra_ss_lib.h`. No test writes BUSY or checks its behavior.
- **`cr_680e463fd93d` (terminal Target status is not completion until MCU writes CMD_STATUS): verified.** The flow checks that SRAM ownership returns to Root after the terminal `TARGET_STATUS`. It does not check what the Requester sees as completion before MCU writes `CMD_STATUS`.
- **`cr_cd3b9f710b55` (CMD_STATUS unused when MCU is the Requester): verified.** I found no test for it. `mci_mbox_dlen_wrap.svh` only mentions Root acting as Requester.
- **`cr_499ce5a87381` (SRAM reads are not destructive): withdrawn.** The owner re-reads the same words in every phase of the flow and each read must return the original data.
